messages:
maria: RC build 2026-03-20-rc3 uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/rc3.tar.gz. Staging preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/rc3. @ajay @kevin please smoke test.
release-bot: CI summary: unit ✅ integration ✅ e2e ✅, perf: flaky on one test (details in CI). artifact sha: abc123def. changelog: routing fix + batching heuristics.
ajay: Quick frontend smoke: chat flow loads, streaming works, tokens look sane. latency p50 ~120ms in staging. no JS errors.
kevin: Backend smoke: embeddings worker threw an NPE on one item, reproducing locally. Triage in progress, might be a bad input edge-case.
sarah: I can take the embedding failure, will patch and push a hotfix if needed. timeline ~30m.
infra-bot: Canary infra ready. Canary group: east-1-canaries. Policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with health checks (error-rate <0.5%, p99 < 800ms). capacity: 12 nodes.
emily: Change window: 18:00-19:00 UTC today. Compliance signoff received for logs retention. PM approves canary.
maria: Proposal: pin runtime to runtime-2.1.4-quant for rc3 to avoid perf variability. @kevin @ajay any objections?
ajay: +1 pin. we've tested runtime-2.1.4-quant in staging.
kevin: +1. no schema migrations in this RC. DB note: safe.
maria: Rollback plan: if canary fails, revert traffic to rc2 and redeploy previous runtime. rollback command: ```./deploy rollback --to rc2 --reason "canary-failure" --force```
kevin: I'll monitor logs and tail the error stream: ```kubectl logs -l app=redwood -c inference --since=10m --follow```
ops-bot: Reminder: watch SLOs and error budget during canary. Set alert thresholds to immediate paging on >0.8% errors.
ajay: I'm signed up for on-call during the window. I'll signal :thumbsup: if healthy, or :rotating_light: to abort.
emily: PM signoff: released features align with rollout plan. GO from PM side.
maria: Engineer signoff: maria, ajay, kevin, sarah all approve promotion to canary.
release-bot: /promote canary rc3 scheduled at 2026-03-20T18:05:00Z by maria.
release-bot: Promotion started: canary -> 5% traffic. Running health checks.
release-bot: Canary 5% checks passed after 10m. Expanding to 25%.
kevin: Observing logs, no new NPEs after sarah's patch. p95 latency stable. :thumbsup:
sarah: Patch deployed to staging and canary. Nice catch.
infra-bot: Canary at 25% stable for 20m. No alerts.
maria: Recommend promote to 100% at 18:40 UTC if no regressions.
ajay: :thumbsup: proceed at your call. I'll be watching.
release-bot: Schedule promotion to 100% at 2026-03-20T18:40:00Z.
release-bot: Promotion to 100% started.
release-bot: Promotion complete. All traffic on rc3.
maria: Deployed to prod. Closing window. Thanks everyone — will open a short rollout notes doc with next steps and retrospective links.
kevin: I'll keep monitoring for 1h post-promote.
emily: PM will update release notes and customer-facing changelog.
maria: Thread closed.
